text:
emily: Quick thread  Marketplace leads + SI co-sell are causing friction. Marketplace sometimes tags an SI as referrer, then AE reassigns. Need a concise rule set.

rahul: Short proposal: source-of-truth = intake_source field. If source = marketplace, marketplace gets initial referral credit; if SI demo follows within 14 days, escalate to co-sell.

nina: Love the 14d window. Also add a required "proof of SI engagement" (short note or demo recording link) to upgrade to co-sell.

marco: For account mapping: if account domain has an existing Redwood contract, Redwood sales owns. If not, ownership follows the co-sell rules.

emily: Proposed simple SFDC automation (ops will implement):
- intake_source (marketplace | si | direct)
- si_engaged (checkbox)
- engagement_proof (url)
- ownership_bucket (Marketplace-Referral | SI-Only | CoSell | Redwood)

jen: Comp/credit defaults for pilot: Marketplace-referral = 60% marketplace credit / 40% Redwood; SI-only = 80% SI; Co-sell = 55% AE / 45% SI. Sales-ops to confirm.

rahul: Add SLA: SI must lodge engagement_proof within 10 business days to retain co-sell status; otherwise ownership reverts to marketplace/referrer.

ops-bot: New doc created: https://confluence.redwood.example.com/display/Partners/Marketplace+%26+SI+CoSell+Rules (permissions: partnerships)

nina: Also flag for joint announcements: if deal > $100k and SI involved, partnerships must sign off on press/announcement language. I'll own the checklist.

marco: I'll scope the SFDC rule changes. Ops ETA 4 business days after approvals.

emily: Good start. Let's pilot for 45 days and capture: % marketplace->co-sell conversions, disputed credits, and time-to-proof. Thanks. :rocket:
